dog.description_text:
Meet Garden!

Garden has quite the story. He was found on the roof of a building and is now searching for a safe place to finally put down roots. This gentle boy may be shy at first, but with a little patience and a pocket full of treats, he begins to come out of his shell.

My Ideal Home

Garden would thrive in a calm, quiet home with someone who understands that trust takes time. Gentle encouragement, a predictable routine, and letting him set the pace will help him grow into a confident companion.

Good with Other Pets?

Garden's history with other animals is unknown. Slow, thoughtful introductions are recommended if he'll be sharing his home with other pets.

I am a playgroup rockstar!

Good with Kids?

Because he's still gaining confidence, ACC recommends an adult-only home.

Things to Know

Garden can be nervous around new people and situations, but he responds well to a slow, low-pressure approach and plenty of positive reinforcement. Give him the time and space he needs, and you'll help this sweet boy truly bloom.
dog.name: Garden
